construction.method_disclosure: Gold `intent` labels were assigned by an AI agent (Hermes subagent), not by a human annotator. ITEM_BANK_SPEC.md approval point 4 requires this be stated. No human pass exists for this pilot bank; inter-annotator agreement between humans is therefore unavailable. The check actually performed is a second pass: (1) an automated single-cue audit over all 120 items (0 violations; each state contains the decisive cue of its gold domain and no cue of another domain), and (2) a full manual re-read of every item against the codebook by the same agent, which altered 2 items for decisiveness before the bank was frozen and rejected 12 borderline candidates (listed under `rejections`). A human second annotator is required before any confirmatory use.
construction.second_pass: automated cue audit (0 hits) + manual re-read (2 pre-freeze amendments)
